rationale: Jiale brings deep expertise in ML infrastructure and distributed training systems from roles at Meta and Uber, while Taylor is building with speech recognition and spatial computing using modern ML tools like Whisper and Fairseq. Taylor's founder perspective on applying ML to real products could benefit from Jiale's systems-level knowledge of scaling ML workloads, and Jiale's research background in deep learning infrastructure could offer valuable technical insights for Dwell's development.
intro_message: Jiale Zhi, meet Taylor L. — Jiale's expertise in scalable ML infrastructure at Meta could complement the ML-driven product work Taylor is doing at Dwell.
